nodes.body_text: function OverviewSection({ c }: { c: Character }) { const d = derivedStats(c); return ( <View className="gap-4"> <View className="flex-row gap-2"> <StatTile label="CA" value={c.armorClass} icon="shield" /> <StatTile label="Iniciativa" value={formatModifier(d.initiative)} icon="flash" /> <StatTile label="Desloc." value={`${d.speed} m`} icon="walk" /> </View> <View className="flex-row gap-2"> <StatTile label="Proficiência" value={formatModifier(d.pb)} /> <StatTile label="Perc. passiva" value={d.passivePerception} /> <StatTile label="XP" value={c.experience ?? 0} /> </View> <Section title="Atributos"> <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-2"> {d.abilities.map((a) => ( <View key={a.key} className="w-[31.5%] items-center rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface py-3"> <Text className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-wider text-ink-faint">{a.abbr}</Text> <Text className="font-display text-2xl text-gold-ink">{formatModifier(a.mod)}</Text> <View className="mt-1 rounded-full bg-surface-3 px-2 py-0.5"> <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-ink-soft">{a.score}</Text> </View> </View> ))} </View> </Section> <Section title="Salvaguardas"> <Card className="gap-1 py-2"> {d.saves.map((s) => ( <View key={s.key} className="flex-row items-center gap-3 py-1.5"> <ProfDot proficient={s.proficient} /> <Text className="flex-1 text-sm text-ink-body">{s.name}</Text> <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink">{formatModifier(s.bonus)}</Text> </View> ))} </Card> </Section> </View> ); }

'font-semibold text-ink' : 'text-ink-body')}>{s.name}</Text> <Muted className="w-8 text-right">{abbr[s.ability]}</Muted> <Text className="w-9 text-right text-sm font-semibold text-ink">{formatModifier(s.bonus)}</Text> </View> ))} </Card> </View> ); }

nodes.name: EquipmentSection
nodes.body_text: function EquipmentSection({ c }: { c: Character }) { const equipment = Array.isArray(c.equipment) ? c.equipment : []; const inventory = Array.isArray(c.inventory) ? c.inventory : []; const anyFlag = equipment.some((e) => e.equipped !== undefined); if (equipment.length === 0 && inventory.length === 0) { return <EmptyState icon="bag-outline" title="Sem equipamento" message="Nenhum item registrado nesta ficha." />; } return ( <View className="gap-4"> {equipment.length > 0 && ( <Section title={`Equipamento (${equipment.length})`}> <Card className="gap-0 py-1"> {equipment.map((e, i) => { const equipped = e.equipped ?? !anyFlag; return ( <View key={`${e.name}-${i}`} className={cx('flex-row items-center gap-3 py-2.5', i > 0 && 'border-t border-line')}> <View className="min-w-0 flex-1"> <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-ink"> {e.name} {(e.quantity ?? 1) > 1 ? ` ×${e.quantity}` : ''} </Text> <Muted> {[e.defense ? `Defesa +${e.defense}` : null, e.attack ? `Ataque +${e.attack}` : null, e.weight ? `${e.weight} kg` : null] .filter(Boolean) .join(' · ') || '—'} </Muted> </View> {equipped && <Badge tone="indigo">Equipado</Badge>} </View> ); })} </Card> </Section> )} {inventory.length > 0 && ( <Section title={`Inventário (${inventory.length})`}> <Card className="gap-0 py-1"> {inventory.map((it, i) => ( <View key={`${it.name}-${i}`} className={cx('flex-row items-center gap-3 py-2.5', i > 0 && 'border-t border-line')}> <Text className="flex-1 text-sm text-ink-body">{it.name}</Text> <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink-soft"> {it.quantity} {it.max && it.max !== it.quantity ? `/${it.max}` : ''} </Text> </View> ))} </Card> </Section> )} </View> ); }

nodes.body_text: function SpellsSection({ api }: { api: CharacterApi }) { const c = api.character!; const d = derivedStats(c); const spells = knownSpells(c); const sheet = getSheet(c); const abilityName = d.spell ? ABILITIES.find((a) => a.key === d.spell!.ability)?.name : undefined; const toggleSlot = (lvlIdx: number, pip: number) => { api.patch( (cur) => { const s = getSheet(cur); const used = [...s.spellSlotsUsed]; while (used.length <= lvlIdx) used.push(0); // Toque num espaço disponível gasta; toque num gasto devolve. used[lvlIdx] = pip < (used[lvlIdx] ?? 0) ? pip : pip + 1; return sheetPatch(cur, { spellSlotsUsed: used }); }, { immediate: true }, ); }; const byLevel = new Map<number, typeof spells>(); for (const s of spells) byLevel.set(s.level, [...(byLevel.get(s.level) ?? []), s]); return ( <View className="gap-4"> {d.spell ? ( <> <View className="flex-row gap-2"> <StatTile label="CD" value={d.spell.dc} icon="shield-half" /> <StatTile label="Ataque" value={formatModifier(d.spell.attack)} icon="flash" /> <StatTile label="Atributo" value={abilityName?.slice(0, 3).toUpperCase() ?? '—'} icon="sparkles" /> </View> {d.spell.slots.some((n) => n > 0) && ( <Section title={d.spell.pact ? 'Espaços de pacto' : 'Espaços de magia'}> <Card className="gap-2 py-3"> {d.spell.slots.map((total, idx) => total > 0 ? ( <View key={idx} className="flex-row items-center gap-3"> <Text className="w-14 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-soft">{idx + 1}º</Text> <View className="flex-1 flex-row flex-wrap gap-2"> {Array.from({ length: total }, (_, pip) => { const spent = pip < (sheet.spellSlotsUsed[idx] ?? 0); return ( <Pressable key={pip} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel={`Espaço de ${idx + 1}º círculo ${spent ? 'gasto' : 'disponível'}`} onPress={() => toggleSlot(idx, pip)} hitSlop={4} className={cx('h-6 w-6 rounded-md border', spent ? 'border-line-strong bg-surface-3' : 'border-violet bg-violet/40')} /> ); })} </View> </View> ) : null, )} <Muted>Toque para gastar ou recuperar um espaço.</Muted> </Card> </Section> )} </> ) : ( <Card> <Muted className="text-center text-sm">Este personagem não conjura magias no nível atual.</Muted> </Card> )} {spells.length === 0 ? ( <EmptyState icon="sparkles-outline" title="Nenhuma magia" message="As magias conhecidas aparecem aqui." /> ) : ( [...byLevel.entries()].map(([lvl, list]) => ( <Section key={lvl} title={lvl === 0 ? 'Concentração' : undefined} subtitle={s.spell ? `${s.spell.school} · ${s.spell.castingTime} · ${s.spell.range}` : undefined} body={s.spell ? [s.spell.description, s.spell.atHigherLevels].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n') : undefined} /> ))} </View> </Section> )) )} </View> ); }

nodes.name: toggleSlot

Conjuração SEMPRE via activeSpellcasting (subclasses conjuradoras). import { ABILITIES, SKILLS, CLASSES, abilityModifier, getClass, getRace, getSpell, proficiencyBonus, spellSlotsFor, type AbilityKey, type SkillKey, type Spell, type SpellcastingInfo, type Subclass, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; /** Patch de colunas que atualiza campos de customData.sheet preservando o resto. */ export const SCORE_FIELDS: Record<AbilityKey, 'strength' | 'dexterity' | 'constitution' | 'intelligence' | 'wisdom' | 'charisma'> = { str: 'strength', dex: 'dexterity', con: 'constitution', int: 'intelligence', wis: 'wisdom', cha: 'charisma', }; /** Id da classe: da ficha nova ou, em fichas antigas, casando pelo nome. */ /** * Conjuração ativa: da classe ou da subclasse (Trapaceiro Arcano e Cavaleiro Arcano * ganham conjuração pelo arquétipo, a partir do nível dele). Nunca ler cls.spellcasting direto. */ /** Bruxo: magia de pacto. */ /** Magias do personagem: ids da ficha nova + entradas antigas em c.spells (ids ou objetos). */ /** Características: classe/subclasse/raça até o nível atual + entradas livres. */ /** Cor da barra de PV conforme a porcentagem. */

nodes.name: norm
nodes.body_text: norm = (s: string) => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase()

nodes.name: activeSpellcasting
nodes.signature: function activeSpellcasting(sheet: Pick<SheetData, 'classId' | 'subclassId'>, level: number): SpellcastingInfo | undefined
nodes.body_text: function activeSpellcasting(sheet: Pick<SheetData, 'classId' | 'subclassId'>, level: number): SpellcastingInfo | undefined { const cls = getClass(sheet.classId); if (cls?.spellcasting) return cls.spellcasting; const sub = cls?.subclasses.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subclassId) as (Subclass & { spellcasting?: SpellcastingInfo }) | undefined; return sub?.spellcasting && level >= sub.level ? sub.spellcasting : undefined; }

nodes.name: pactSlots
nodes.body_text: function pactSlots(level: number): number[] { const count = level === 1 ? 1 : level < 11 ? 2 : level < 17 ? 3 : 4; const slotLevel = Math.min(5, Math.ceil(level / 2)); const arr: number[] = Array(slotLevel).fill(0); arr[slotLevel - 1] = count; return arr; }

nodes.name: derivedStats
nodes.body_text: function derivedStats(c: Character) { const sheet = getSheet(c); const pb = proficiencyBonus(c.level); const mod = (k: AbilityKey) => abilityModifier(scoreOf(c, k)); const abilities = ABILITIES.map((a) => ({ ...a, score: scoreOf(c, a.key), mod: mod(a.key) })); const saves = ABILITIES.map((a) => { const proficient = sheet.savingThrowProficiencies.includes(a.key); return { ...a, proficient, bonus: mod(a.key) + (proficient ? pb : 0) }; }); const skills = SKILLS.map((s) => { const proficient = sheet.skillProficiencies.includes(s.key); const expertise = sheet.skillExpertise.includes(s.key); return { ...s, proficient, expertise, bonus: mod(s.ability) + (expertise ? pb * 2 : proficient ? pb : 0) }; }); const sc = activeSpellcasting(sheet, c.level); const spell = sc ? { ability: sc.ability, dc: 8 + pb + mod(sc.ability), attack: pb + mod(sc.ability), pact: sc.kind === 'pact', slots: sc.kind === 'pact' ? pactSlots(c.level) : spellSlotsFor(sc.kind, c.level), } : null; const race = getRace(sheet.raceId); const subrace = race?.subraces.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subraceId); return { pb, initiative: mod('dex'), passivePerception: 10 + (skills.find((s) => s.key === 'percepcao')?.bonus ?? 0), speed: subrace?.speed ?? race?.speed ?? 9, abilities, saves, skills, spell, }; }

nodes.name: mod

nodes.body_text: function knownSpells(c: Character): { id: string; name: string; level: number; spell?: Spell; prepared: boolean }[] { const sheet = getSheet(c); const ids = new Set<string>([...sheet.spellsKnown]); for (const s of Array.isArray(c.spells) ? c.spells : []) { if (typeof s === 'string') ids.add(s); } const out: { id: string; name: string; level: number; spell?: Spell; prepared: boolean }[] = []; for (const id of ids) { const spell = getSpell(id); out.push({ id, name: spell?.name ?? id, level: spell?.level ?? 0, spell, prepared: sheet.spellsPrepared.includes(id) }); } for (const s of Array.isArray(c.spells) ? c.spells : []) { if (s && typeof s === 'object' && typeof s.name === 'string') { out.push({ id: `custom-${s.name}`, name: s.name, level: Number(s.level) || 0, prepared: false }); } } return out.sort((a, b) => a.level - b.level || a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'pt-BR')); }

nodes.body_text: import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'; import { Alert } from 'react-native'; import { getCharacter, updateCharacter, type Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { useRequiredSession } from '@/lib/session'; const DEBOUNCE_MS = 600; /** * Carrega um personagem e aplica edições de forma otimista. * As alterações aparecem na hora, são enviadas em lote (debounce) e, se o servidor * recusar, a tela volta para o último estado confirmado. */

nodes.name: useCharacter
nodes.body_text: function useCharacter(id: string) { const { username, role } = useRequiredSession(); const [character, setCharacter] = useState<Character | null>(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null); const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false); const currentRef = useRef<Character | null>(null); const confirmedRef = useRef<Character | null>(null); const pendingRef = useRef<Partial<Character>>({}); const timerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null); const chainRef = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve()); const apply = useCallback((c: Character | null) => { currentRef.current = c; setCharacter(c); }, []); const load = useCallback(async () => { setError(null); try { const c = await getCharacter(id, username); confirmedRef.current = c; apply(c); } catch (e) { setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Erro ao carregar ficha'); } finally { setLoading(false); } }, [id, username, apply]); useEffect(() => { void load(); }, [load]); const flush = useCallback(() => { if (timerRef.current) { clearTimeout(timerRef.current); timerRef.current = null; } const payload = pendingRef.current; if (Object.keys(payload).length === 0) return chainRef.current; pendingRef.current = {}; setSaving(true); chainRef.current = chainRef.current.then(async () => { try { await updateCharacter(id, username, payload); if (confirmedRef.current) confirmedRef.current = { ...confirmedRef.current, ...payload }; } catch (e) { // Desfaz tudo o que não foi confirmado (inclusive alterações ainda pendentes). pendingRef.current = {}; if (timerRef.current) { clearTimeout(timerRef.current); timerRef.current = null; } apply(confirmedRef.current); Alert.alert('Não foi possível salvar', e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Tente novamente.'); } finally { if (Object.keys(pendingRef.current).length === 0) setSaving(false); } }); return chainRef.current; }, [id, username, apply]); /** Aplica na tela e agenda o envio. `immediate` envia já (sem debounce). */ const patch = useCallback( (partial: Partial<Character> | ((c: Character) => Partial<Character>), opts: { immediate?: boolean } = {}) => { const cur = currentRef.current; if (!cur) return; const p = typeof partial === 'function' ? partial(cur) : partial; apply({ ...cur, ...p }); pendingRef.current = { ...pendingRef.current, ...p }; if (opts.immediate) { void flush(); return; } if (timerRef.current) clearTimeout(timerRef.current); timerRef.current = setTimeout(() => void flush(), DEBOUNCE_MS); }, [apply, flush], ); // Ao sair da tela, envia o que estiver pendente. useEffect(() => () => void flush(), [flush]); return { character, loading, error, saving, username, role, patch, reload: load, flush }; }

'MASTER' : 'PLAYER' }); } finally { setLoading(false); } })(); }, []); const signIn = useCallback(async (username: string, role: Role) => { const user = await apiLogin(username, role); const next: Session = { username: user.username, role: user.role }; await AsyncStorage.multiSet([ [KEY_USERNAME, next.username], [KEY_ROLE, next.role], [KEY_ACTIVE, '1'], ]); setLastUsername(next.username); setSession(next); }, []); const signOut = useCallback(async () => { await AsyncStorage.setItem(KEY_ACTIVE, '0'); setSession(null); }, []); const value = useMemo( () => ({ session, loading, lastUsername, signIn, signOut }), [session, loading, lastUsername, signIn, signOut], ); return <SessionContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</SessionContext.Provider>; }

nodes.body_text: function load() { if (loaded || typeof window === "undefined") return; loaded = true; try { const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(KEY); if (raw) { const parsed = JSON.parse(raw); if (Array.isArray(parsed)) history = parsed.slice(0, MAX); } } catch { /* storage indisponível */ } }

(JSON.parse(e.newValue) as DiceRoll[]) : EMPTY; } catch { history = EMPTY; } cb(); } }; window.addEventListener("storage", onStorage); return () => { listeners.delete(cb); window.removeEventListener("storage", onStorage); }; }

nodes.body_text: function performRoll(expr: string, mode: RollMode = "normal"): DiceRoll | null { const clean = expr.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ""); const first = rollDice(clean); if (!first) return null; const isD20 = D20_RE.test(clean); let used = first; let discarded: DiceRoll["discarded"]; const effMode: RollMode = isD20 ? mode : "normal"; if (effMode !== "normal") { const second = rollDice(clean)!; const pickFirst = effMode === "advantage" ? first.total >= second.total : first.total <= second.total; used = pickFirst ? first : second; const other = pickFirst ? second : first; discarded = { rolls: other.rolls, total: other.total }; } const crit: Crit = isD20 ? (used.rolls[0] === 20 ? "max" : used.rolls[0] === 1 ? "min" : null) : null; return { id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`, expr: clean, rolls: used.rolls, bonus: used.bonus, total: used.total, mode: effMode, discarded, crit, at: Date.now(), }; }

nodes.body_text: function useDiceRoller() { const rolls = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getServerSnapshot); /** Rola uma expressão e grava no histórico. */ const roll = useCallback((expr: string, mode: RollMode = "normal"): DiceRoll | null => { const r = performRoll(expr, mode); if (r) commit([r, ...history].slice(0, MAX)); return r; }, []); /** Rola um único dado (ex.: rollDie(20, "advantage")). */ const rollDie = useCallback( (sides: number, mode: RollMode = "normal") => roll(`1d${sides}`, mode), [roll], ); const clear = useCallback(() => commit(EMPTY), []); return { history: rolls, last: rolls[0] ?? null, roll, rollDie, clear }; }

Puro: só depende de @repo/rules. import { ACTION_COST_LABEL, ARMOR, BACKGROUNDS, COMBAT_ACTIONS, CONDITIONS, GEAR, RULE_SECTIONS, WEAPONS, featureActionCost, getBackground, getClass, getRace, getSpell, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { EntryRef, ResolvedEntry } from './types'; /** Busca por nome ignorando caixa e acentos (nomes vêm digitados à mão na ficha). */ /** Nomes usados nas fichas de papel para itens que têm outro nome na tabela de equipamento. */ const GEAR_ALIASES: Record<string, string> = { 'kit do aventureiro': 'Pacote de Aventureiro', 'corda': 'Corda de cânhamo (15 metros)', 'racao': 'Rações de viagem (1 dia)', 'racoes': 'Rações de viagem (1 dia)', 'pecas de ladinagem': 'Ferramentas de ladrão', 'ferramentas de ladinagem': 'Ferramentas de ladrão', }; /** Ref para um item digitado na ficha: tenta arma, armadura e equipamento, nessa ordem. */

nodes.name: norm
nodes.body_text: norm = (s: string) => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').trim().toLowerCase()

nodes.name: byName
nodes.signature: byName = <T extends { name: string }>(list: T[], name: string)
nodes.body_text: byName = <T extends { name: string }>(list: T[], name: string) => { const n = norm(name); return list.find((x) => norm(x.name) === n); }

nodes.name: findGear
nodes.body_text: findGear = (name: string) => byName(GEAR, GEAR_ALIASES[norm(name)] ?? name)

nodes.name: costMeta
nodes.body_text: costMeta = (description: string, name: string) => { const cost = featureActionCost(description, name); return cost === 'passivo' ? [] : [{ label: 'Uso', value: ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost] }]; }

nodes.name: Tilt

nodes.body_text: function Tilt({ children, className, max = 6, liftOnly = false }: TiltProps) { const reduce = useReducedMotion(); const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null); const px = useMotionValue(0.5); const py = useMotionValue(0.5); const sx = useSpring(px, { stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }); const sy = useSpring(py, { stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }); const rotateY = useTransform(sx, [0, 1], [-max, max]); const rotateX = useTransform(sy, [0, 1], [max, -max]); const tilt = !reduce && !liftOnly; return ( <motion.div ref={ref} className={cn('will-change-transform', className)} style={tilt ? { rotateX, rotateY, transformPerspective: 800 } : undefined} whileHover={reduce ? undefined : { y: -4 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 24 }} onPointerMove={(e) => { if (!tilt || !ref.current) return; const r = ref.current.getBoundingClientRect(); px.set((e.clientX - r.left) / r.width); py.set((e.clientY - r.top) / r.height); }} onPointerLeave={() => { px.set(0.5); py.set(0.5); }} > {children} </motion.div> ); }

nodes.body_text: function readRecents(): string[] { try { const v: unknown = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RECENT_KEY) ?? '[]'); return Array.isArray(v) ? v.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string').slice(0, MAX_RECENT) : []; } catch { return []; } }

nodes.name: writeRecent
nodes.body_text: function writeRecent(q: string): void { const value = q.trim(); if (!value) return; try { const next = [value, ...readRecents().filter((x) => norm(x) !== norm(value))].slice(0, MAX_RECENT); localStorage.setItem(RECENT_KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* sem storage */ } }

nodes.signature: function Highlight({ text, terms }: { text: string; terms: string[] })
nodes.body_text: function Highlight({ text, terms }: { text: string; terms: string[] }) { if (!terms.length) return <>{text}</>; let n = ''; const map: number[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) { const c = norm(text[i]!); for (let j = 0; j < c.length; j++) { n += c[j]; map.push(i); } } const ranges: [number, number][] = []; for (const t of terms) { if (t.length < 2) continue; let from = 0; for (;;) { const at = n.indexOf(t, from); if (at < 0) break; from = at + t.length; if (at > 0 && /[a-z0-9]/.test(n[at - 1]!)) continue; ranges.push([map[at]!, (map[at + t.length - 1] ?? text.length - 1) + 1]); } } if (!ranges.length) return <>{text}</>; ranges.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]); const parts: React.ReactNode[] = []; let pos = 0; ranges.forEach(([s, e]) => { if (e <= pos) return; const start = Math.max(s, pos); if (start > pos) parts.push(text.slice(pos, start)); parts.push(<mark key={start} className="rounded-sm bg-indigo-500/30 text-inherit">{text.slice(start, e)}</mark>); pos = e; }); parts.push(text.slice(pos)); return <>{parts}</>; }

nodes.body_text: // Ícone de cada carta de ação, no estilo de "botão de habilidade" dos RPGs táticos: // moldura na cor do custo, fundo escuro com brilho e silhueta com gradiente. import { useId } from 'react'; import { normalizeText } from '@/components/spells/spell-utils'; import { ICON_PATHS, type IconId } from './action-icon-paths'; import type { ActionCard } from './action-cards'; const COMBAT_ICONS: Record<string, IconId> = { atacar: 'crossed-swords', conjurar: 'spell-book', disparada: 'sprint', desengajar: 'exit-door', esquivar: 'dodging', ajudar: 'shaking-hands', esconder: 'hood', preparar: 'hourglass', procurar: 'magnifying-glass', 'usar-objeto': 'standing-potion', agarrar: 'grab', empurrar: 'push', 'duas-armas': 'crossed-sabres', 'ataque-de-oportunidade': 'sword-slice', 'reacao-preparada': 'stopwatch', }; /** Características conhecidas; o resto cai no ícone genérico. Chave = nome normalizado. */ const FEATURE_ICONS: Record<string, IconId> = { furia: 'enrage', 'arma de sopro': 'dragon-breath', 'acao ardilosa': 'cloak-dagger', 'esquiva sobrenatural': 'shield-reflect', 'inspiracao de bardo': 'spark-spirit', 'forma selvagem': 'claw-slashes', 'segundo folego': 'health', 'surto de acao': 'whirlwind', 'imposicao das maos': 'magic-palm', }; /** Primeira regra que casa com o nome da arma. */ const WEAPON_ICONS: [RegExp, IconId][] = [ [/machad|martelo|maca|mangual|picareta|alabarda|glaive|malho/, 'battle-axe'], [/arco|besta|funda|zarabatana/, 'pocket-bow'], [/azagaia|lanca|tridente|dardo|pique/, 'spear'], [/adaga|punhal|faca/, 'thrown-daggers'], [/desarmad|soco|punho/, 'fist'], ]; /** Magias pelo efeito descrito; ordem importa (cura antes de dano). */ const SPELL_ICONS: [RegExp, IconId][] = [ [/recupera .*pontos de vida|cura|curar/, 'health'], [/teletransport|desaparece e reaparece/, 'teleport'], [/dano de fogo|chamas/, 'fireball'], [/dano de frio|gelo/, 'ice-bolt'], [/dano eletrico|dano de trovao|relampago|raio/, 'lightning-arc'], [/dano necrotico|morte/, 'death-zone'], [/dano radiante|luz/, 'sparkles'], ]; /** Silhueta do ícone com gradiente creme → cor da seção; o tamanho vem de `className`. */

nodes.name: iconFor
nodes.body_text: function iconFor(card: ActionCard): IconId { const e = card.entry; if (e.kind === 'action') return COMBAT_ICONS[e.id] ?? 'beveled-star'; if (e.kind === 'weapon') { const n = normalizeText(card.name); if (card.source.includes('distância') && !/azagaia|lanca|dardo|adaga/.test(n)) return 'pocket-bow'; return WEAPON_ICONS.find(([re]) => re.test(n))?.[1] ?? 'broadsword'; } if (card.spell) { const t = normalizeText(card.spell.description); return SPELL_ICONS.find(([re]) => re.test(t))?.[1] ?? (card.spell.level === 0 ? 'magic-swirl' : 'rolling-energy'); } return FEATURE_ICONS[normalizeText(card.name)] ?? 'beveled-star'; }

Puro: sem React. import { ACTION_COST_LABEL, COMBAT_ACTIONS, abilityModifier, featureActionCost, getBackground, getClass, getRace, getSpell, spellActionCost, type ActionCost, type Spell, type Weapon, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { activeSpellcasting, derivedStats, getSheet, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import type { EntryRef } from '@/components/entries'; import { spellRollFor } from '@/components/spells/filters'; import { normalizeText } from '@/components/spells/spell-utils'; import { queryEmpty, scoreSpell, scoreText, type ParsedQuery } from '@/components/spells/smart-search'; import { lookupItem, weaponProficient } from './equipment-logic'; /** Slot do turno gasto ao usar a carta. */ export const SECTIONS: { id: CardSection; title: string; color: string }[] = [ { id: 'acao', title: 'Ação', color: '#6366f1' }, { id: 'bonus', title: 'Ação bônus', color: '#f5c451' }, { id: 'reacao', title: 'Reação', color: '#38bdf8' }, { id: 'truque', title: 'Truques', color: '#8b5cf6' }, { id: 'outro', title: 'Conjuração longa', color: '#94a3b8' }, ]; /** Primeira frase do texto, limitada para caber na carta. */ /** Resumos em que a primeira frase não diz o que a característica faz. */ const SUMMARY_OVERRIDES: Record<string, string> = { 'Ação Ardilosa': 'Disparada, Desengajar ou Esconder como ação bônus.', }; /* ---------- Armas ---------- */ /* ---------- Magias ---------- */ const SAVE_ABBR: Record<string, string> = { forca: 'FOR', destreza: 'DES', constituicao: 'CON', inteligencia: 'INT', sabedoria: 'SAB', carisma: 'CAR', }; /** Dano do truque cresce nos níveis 5, 11 e 17 do personagem. */ /* ---------- Lista completa ---------- */ /** * Pontua a carta para a busca inteligente; -1 = fora. Magias usam o índice completo; * as demais cartas, nome + texto da carta. Atalhos de magia (círculo, concentração...) excluem não-magias. */ /** Condições que dão desvantagem em ataques (diferente de testes de habilidade). */ /** Menor círculo com espaço livre para conjurar a magia. Retorna null quando não há. */

Math.max(str, dex) : str; const prof = weaponProficient(getClass(sheet.classId), w); const bonus = mod + (prof ? d.pb : 0) + attackBonus; const dice = w.damage.match(/^\d+d\d+/)?.[0]; const damage: DamageRoll[] = []; if (dice) damage.push({ label: 'Dano', expr: `${dice}${fmtMod(mod)}` }); const sneak = sheet.classId === 'ladino' && (finesse || ranged) ? `${Math.ceil(c.level / 2)}d6` : null; if (sneak) damage.push({ label: 'Furtivo', expr: sneak }); return { key, section: 'acao', name: w.name, cost: 'acao', costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL.acao, source: `Arma ${w.kind === 'À distância' ? 'à distância' : 'corpo a corpo'}`, summary: w.properties.join(' · ') || 'Sem propriedades especiais.', stats: [ `Ataque ${bonus >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${bonus}${prof ? '' : ' (sem proficiência)'}`, dice ? `${dice}${fmtMod(mod)} ${w.damage.slice(dice.length).trim()}` : w.damage, ...(sneak ? [`Ataque Furtivo +${sneak}`] : []), ], entry: { kind: 'weapon', name: w.name }, attack: { label: `Ataque com ${w.name}`, bonus }, damage, }; }

'Cura' : 'Dano'; if (s.level > 0) return { label, expr: r.expr }; const m = r.expr.match(/^(\d+)(d.+)$/); return { label, expr: m ? `${Number(m[1]) * cantripTier(level)}${m[2]}` : r.expr }; }

'truque' : sectionOf(cost), name: s.name, cost, costLabel: asSlot(cost) ? ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost] : s.castingTime, source: s.level === 0 ? 'Truque' : `Magia de ${s.level}º círculo`, summary: firstSentence(s.description), stats: [ s.range, s.duration, ...(dmg ? [`${dmg.label} ${dmg.expr}`] : []), ...(save && spell ? [`CD ${spell.dc} ${SAVE_ABBR[save]}`] : []), ...(s.concentration && !/concentra/i.test(s.duration) ? ['Concentração'] : []), ], entry: { kind: 'spell', id: s.id }, attack: hasAttack && spell ? { label: `Ataque de ${s.name}`, bonus: spell.attack } : undefined, damage: dmg ? [dmg] : [], spell: s, }; }

nodes.name: buildActionCards
nodes.body_text: function buildActionCards(c: Character): ActionCard[] { const sheet = getSheet(c); const cards: ActionCard[] = []; // Ordem das seções: o que é do personagem primeiro; regras básicas no fim. (c.equipment ?? []).forEach((it, i) => { const l = lookupItem(it.name); if (l?.kind === 'weapon') cards.push(weaponCard(c, sheet, l.weapon, it.attack ?? 0, `weapon:${i}:${l.weapon.name}`)); }); const pushTrait = (key: string, name: string, description: string, source: string, entry: EntryRef) => { const cost = featureActionCost(description, name); if (cost === 'passivo') return; cards.push({ key, section: sectionOf(cost), name, cost, costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost], source, summary: SUMMARY_OVERRIDES[name] ?? firstSentence(description), stats: [], entry, damage: [], }); }; const cls = getClass(sheet.classId); const sub = cls?.subclasses.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subclassId); for (const f of cls?.features ?? []) { if (f.level <= c.level) pushTrait(`feature:${f.name}`, f.name, f.description, cls!.name, { kind: 'feature', classId: sheet.classId, name: f.name }); } for (const f of sub?.features ?? []) { if (f.level <= c.level) pushTrait(`feature:${sub!.id}:${f.name}`, f.name, f.description, sub!.name, { kind: 'feature', classId: sheet.classId, subclassId: sub!.id, name: f.name }); } const race = getRace(sheet.raceId); const subrace = race?.subraces.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subraceId); for (const t of race?.traits ?? []) pushTrait(`trait:${t.name}`, t.name, t.description, race!.name, { kind: 'trait', raceId: race!.id, name: t.name }); for (const t of subrace?.traits ?? []) pushTrait(`trait:${subrace!.id}:${t.name}`, t.name, t.description, subrace!.name, { kind: 'trait', raceId: race!.id, subraceId: subrace!.id, name: t.name }); const bg = getBackground(sheet.backgroundId); if (bg) pushTrait(`background:${bg.id}`, bg.feature.name, bg.feature.description, bg.name, { kind: 'background', id: bg.id }); const prepares = activeSpellcasting(sheet, c.level)?.preparesSpells; for (const id of sheet.spellsKnown) { const s = getSpell(id); if (s && (s.level === 0 || !prepares || sheet.spellsPrepared.includes(id))) cards.push(spellCard(c, s)); } for (const a of COMBAT_ACTIONS) { cards.push({ key: `action:${a.id}`, section: sectionOf(a.cost), name: a.name, cost: a.cost, costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL[a.cost], source: 'Regra básica', summary: a.summary, stats: [], entry: { kind: 'action', id: a.id }, damage: [], }); } return cards; }

nodes.body_text: function cardScore(card: ActionCard, pq: ParsedQuery): number { if (queryEmpty(pq)) return 0; if (card.spell) return scoreSpell(card.spell, pq); if (pq.level !== undefined || pq.concentration || pq.ritual || pq.school || pq.classId) return -1; if (pq.cost && card.cost !== pq.cost) return -1; return scoreText(normalizeText(card.name), normalizeText(`${card.source} ${card.summary} ${card.stats.join(' ')}`), pq); }

nodes.name: effects.ts
nodes.body_text: // Efeitos mecânicos automáticos de condições e exaustão (5e), usados em avisos e rolagens. import type { SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; export const EXHAUSTION_EFFECTS = [ 'Sem exaustão', 'Desvantagem em testes de habilidade', 'Deslocamento reduzido à metade', 'Desvantagem em ataques e salvaguardas', 'PV máximos reduzidos à metade', 'Deslocamento reduzido a 0', 'Morte', ]; /** Fontes de desvantagem automática para um tipo de rolagem. */ /** Avisos curtos para o painel de condições. */

nodes.name: RollKind
nodes.body_text: type RollKind = 'check' | 'save' | 'none';

nodes.name: disadvantageSources
nodes.signature: function disadvantageSources(sheet: SheetData, kind: RollKind): string[]
nodes.body_text: function disadvantageSources(sheet: SheetData, kind: RollKind): string[] { if (kind === 'none') return []; const out: string[] = []; const has = (id: string) => sheet.conditions.includes(id); if (kind === 'check') { if (sheet.exhaustion >= 1) out.push(`Exaustão ${sheet.exhaustion}`); if (has('envenenado')) out.push('Envenenado'); if (has('amedrontado')) out.push('Amedrontado'); } else if (sheet.exhaustion >= 3) { out.push(`Exaustão ${sheet.exhaustion}`); } return out; }

nodes.name: effectWarnings
nodes.body_text: function effectWarnings(sheet: SheetData): string[] { const w: string[] = []; const has = (id: string) => sheet.conditions.includes(id); const ex = sheet.exhaustion; if (ex >= 1) w.push('Desvantagem em testes de habilidade (exaustão).'); if (ex >= 2) w.push('Deslocamento pela metade (exaustão).'); if (ex >= 3) w.push('Desvantagem em ataques e salvaguardas (exaustão).'); if (ex >= 4) w.push('PV máximos pela metade (exaustão).'); if (ex >= 5) w.push('Deslocamento 0 (exaustão).'); if (ex >= 6) w.push('Exaustão 6: morte.'); if (has('envenenado')) w.push('Envenenado: desvantagem em ataques e testes de habilidade.'); if (has('amedrontado')) w.push('Amedrontado: desvantagem em ataques e testes de habilidade com a fonte do medo à vista.'); if (has('cego')) w.push('Cego: desvantagem em ataques; falha em testes que exigem visão.'); if (has('caido')) w.push('Caído: desvantagem em ataques.'); if (has('impedido')) w.push('Impedido: deslocamento 0, desvantagem em ataques e salvaguardas de Destreza.'); if (['atordoado', 'paralisado', 'inconsciente', 'petrificado'].some(has)) w.push('Falha automática em salvaguardas de Força e Destreza.'); if (['atordoado', 'paralisado', 'inconsciente', 'incapacitado'].some(has)) w.push('Incapacitado: sem ações ou reações.'); if (has('agarrado')) w.push('Agarrado: deslocamento 0.'); return w; }

nodes.name: equipment-logic.ts
nodes.body_text: import { ARMOR, GEAR, WEAPONS, abilityModifier, proficiencyBonus, type ArmorItem, type ClassDef, type Weapon } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character, Equipment } from '@/lib/api'; import type { Coins } from '@/lib/sheet'; /* ---------- Busca nas tabelas de regras ---------- */ /** "6,5 kg" -> 6.5; "—" -> undefined. */ /* ---------- Equipar ---------- */ /** * Dados antigos não têm o campo `equipped`: se nenhum item o define, tudo conta como equipado. * Assim a CA calculada de fichas existentes não muda até o jogador usar os botões de equipar. */ /** Alterna `equipped` do item i; só uma armadura de corpo e um escudo por vez. */ /* ---------- Peso ---------- */ /** Regra variante (kg): sobrecarregado > For x 2,5; muito sobrecarregado > For x 5. */ /** 50 moedas = 0,5 kg. */ /* ---------- Moedas ---------- */ export const COIN_ORDER: CoinKey[] = ['pp', 'gp', 'ep', 'sp', 'cp']; export const COIN_LABEL: Record<CoinKey, string> = { pp: 'PL', gp: 'PO', ep: 'PE', sp: 'PP', cp: 'PC' }; export const COIN_NAME: Record<CoinKey, string> = { pp: 'Platina', gp: 'Ouro', ep: 'Electro', sp: 'Prata', cp: 'Cobre' }; const CP: Record<CoinKey, number> = { pp: 1000, gp: 100, ep: 50, sp: 10, cp: 1 }; /** Troca `amount` moedas de `from` pelo máximo possível de `to`. */ /* ---------- Proficiência e requisitos ---------- */ /* ---------- Ataques ---------- */ /** Dobra os dados (crítico) mantendo o bônus fixo. */ /* ---------- Avisos do equipamento em uso ---------- */

nodes.name: normName
nodes.body_text: normName = (s: string) => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s*\(.*\)\s*$/, '').trim()

nodes.name: parseKg
nodes.signature: function parseKg(s: string | undefined): number | undefined
nodes.body_text: function parseKg(s: string | undefined): number | undefined { if (!s) return undefined; const m = s.match(/(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*kg/i); return m ? Number(m[1]!.replace(',', '.')) : undefined; }

nodes.name: Lookup
nodes.signature: type Lookup = | { kind: 'armor'; armor: ArmorItem; weight?: number } | { kind: 'weapon'; weapon: Weapon; weight?: number } | { kind: 'gear'; weight?: number };
nodes.body_text: type Lookup = | { kind: 'armor'; armor: ArmorItem; weight?: number } | { kind: 'weapon'; weapon: Weapon; weight?: number } | { kind: 'gear'; weight?: number };

nodes.name: lookupItem
nodes.body_text: function lookupItem(name: string): Lookup | null { const n = normName(name); if (!n) return null; const armor = ARMOR.find((a) => normName(a.name) === n); if (armor) return { kind: 'armor', armor, weight: parseKg(armor.weight) }; const weapon = WEAPONS.find((w) => normName(w.name) === n); if (weapon) return { kind: 'weapon', weapon, weight: parseKg(weapon.weight) }; const gear = GEAR.find((g) => normName(g.name) === n); if (gear) return { kind: 'gear', weight: parseKg(gear.weight) }; return null; }

nodes.name: knownItemNames
nodes.body_text: knownItemNames = (): string[] => [ ...ARMOR.map((a) => a.name), ...WEAPONS.map((w) => w.name), ...GEAR.map((g) => g.name), ]

nodes.name: fmtKg
nodes.body_text: fmtKg = (n: number) => `${(Math.round(n * 100) / 100).toLocaleString('pt-BR')} kg`

nodes.name: isBody
nodes.body_text: isBody = (it: Equipment) => { const l = lookupItem(it.name); return l?.kind === 'armor' && l.armor.category !== 'Escudo'; }

nodes.name: isShield
nodes.body_text: isShield = (it: Equipment) => { const l = lookupItem(it.name); return l?.kind === 'armor' && l.armor.category === 'Escudo'; }

nodes.name: isEquipped
nodes.signature: function isEquipped(items: Equipment[], it: Equipment): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isEquipped(items: Equipment[], it: Equipment): boolean { if (it.equipped !== undefined) return it.equipped; return items.every((x) => x.equipped === undefined); }

nodes.name: toggleEquipped
nodes.signature: function toggleEquipped(items: Equipment[], i: number): Equipment[]
nodes.body_text: function toggleEquipped(items: Equipment[], i: number): Equipment[] { const target = items[i]; if (!target) return items; const on = !isEquipped(items, target); return items.map((x, j) => { const cur = isEquipped(items, x); if (j === i) return { ...x, equipped: on }; if (on && ((isBody(target) && isBody(x)) || (isShield(target) && isShield(x)))) return { ...x, equipped: false }; return { ...x, equipped: cur }; }); }

nodes.name: carryCapacity
nodes.body_text: carryCapacity = (str: number) => str * 7.5

nodes.name: encumbrance
nodes.signature: function encumbrance(total: number, str: number): { label: string; tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad' }
nodes.body_text: function encumbrance(total: number, str: number): { label: string; tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'bad' } { if (total > str * 5) return { label: 'Muito sobrecarregado (−6 m de deslocamento; desvantagem em testes, ataques e salvaguardas de For/Des/Con)', tone: 'bad' }; if (total > str * 2.5) return { label: 'Sobrecarregado (−3 m de deslocamento)', tone: 'warn' }; return { label: 'Carga normal', tone: 'ok' }; }

nodes.name: coinWeight
nodes.body_text: coinWeight = (c: Coins) => (c.pp + c.gp + c.ep + c.sp + c.cp) / 100

nodes.name: itemsWeight
nodes.signature: function itemsWeight(items: { weight?: number; quantity?: number }[])
nodes.body_text: function itemsWeight(items: { weight?: number; quantity?: number }[]) { return items.reduce((s, it) => s + (it.weight ?? 0) * (it.quantity ?? 1), 0); }

nodes.name: CoinKey
nodes.body_text: type CoinKey = keyof Coins;

nodes.name: totalInGold
nodes.body_text: totalInGold = (c: Coins) => COIN_ORDER.reduce((s, k) => s + c[k] * CP[k], 0) / 100

nodes.name: exchangeCoins
nodes.signature: function exchangeCoins(c: Coins, from: CoinKey, to: CoinKey, amount: number): { coins: Coins; got: number; spent: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function exchangeCoins(c: Coins, from: CoinKey, to: CoinKey, amount: number): { coins: Coins; got: number; spent: number } | null { if (from === to) return null; const amt = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount)), c[from]); const got = Math.floor((amt * CP[from]) / CP[to]); const spent = Math.ceil((got * CP[to]) / CP[from]); if (got <= 0) return null; return { coins: { ...c, [from]: c[from] - spent, [to]: c[to] + got }, got, spent }; }

nodes.name: singular
nodes.body_text: singular = (s: string) => normName(s).split(/\s+/).map((w) => (w.length > 3 ? w.replace(/s$/, '') : w)).join(' ')

nodes.name: armorProficient
nodes.signature: function armorProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, a: ArmorItem): boolean
nodes.body_text: function armorProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, a: ArmorItem): boolean { if (!cls) return true; const p = cls.armorProficiencies.map(normName).join(' | '); if (/todas as armaduras/.test(p)) return true; if (a.category === 'Escudo') return /escudo/.test(p); const key = a.category === 'Leve' ? 'leve' : a.category === 'Média' ? 'media' : 'pesada'; return p.includes(key); }

nodes.name: weaponProficient
nodes.signature: function weaponProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, w: Weapon): boolean
nodes.body_text: function weaponProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, w: Weapon): boolean { if (!cls) return true; const list = cls.weaponProficiencies.map(normName); const cat = w.category === 'Simples' ? 'simples' : 'marciais'; if (list.some((p) => (p.includes('armas') || p.includes('todas')) && (p.includes(cat) || (cat === 'marciais' && p.includes('marcial'))))) return true; const name = singular(w.name); return list.some((p) => singular(p) === name); }

nodes.name: AttackInfo
nodes.body_text: interface AttackInfo { name: string; attackBonus: number; /** Expressão rolável (ex.: "1d8+3") ou null quando a arma não é da tabela. */ damageExpr: string | null; damageLabel: string; proficient: boolean; ability: 'For' | 'Des' | null; properties: string[]; }

nodes.name: weaponAttack
nodes.signature: function weaponAttack(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, it: Equipment): AttackInfo | null
nodes.body_text: function weaponAttack(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, it: Equipment): AttackInfo | null { const l = lookupItem(it.name); const magic = it.attack ?? 0; if (l?.kind !== 'weapon') { if (!magic) return null; return { name: it.name || 'Ataque', attackBonus: magic, damageExpr: null, damageLabel: '', proficient: false, ability: null, properties: [] }; } const w = l.weapon; const str = abilityModifier(c.strength), dex = abilityModifier(c.dexterity); const finesse = w.properties.includes('Acuidade'); const ability: 'For' | 'Des' = w.kind === 'À distância' ? 'Des' : finesse && dex > str ? 'Des' : 'For'; const mod = ability === 'Des' ? dex : str; const proficient = weaponProficient(cls, w); const dm = w.damage.match(/^(\d*d\d+|\d+)\s*(.*)$/); const dice = dm?.[1]; const bonus = mod + magic; const damageExpr = dice && /d/.test(dice) ? `${dice}${bonus ? (bonus > 0 ? `+${bonus}` : `${bonus}`) : ''}` : null; return { name: w.name, attackBonus: mod + (proficient ? proficiencyBonus(c.level) : 0) + magic, damageExpr, damageLabel: dm?.[2] ?? '', proficient, ability, properties: w.properties, }; }

nodes.name: critExpr
nodes.body_text: function critExpr(expr: string): string { return expr.replace(/^(\d*)d/, (_, n) => `${(Number(n || 1)) * 2}d`); }

nodes.name: equipWarnings
nodes.signature: function equipWarnings(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, items: Equipment[]): string[]
nodes.body_text: function equipWarnings(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, items: Equipment[]): string[] { const out: string[] = []; for (const it of items) { if (!isEquipped(items, it)) continue; const l = lookupItem(it.name); if (l?.kind === 'armor') { if (!armorProficient(cls, l.armor)) out.push(`Sem proficiência com ${l.armor.name}: desvantagem em testes/ataques/salvaguardas de For e Des e não pode conjurar.`); if (l.armor.strengthReq && c.strength < l.armor.strengthReq) out.push(`${l.armor.name} exige For ${l.armor.strengthReq}: −3 m de deslocamento.`); if (l.armor.stealthDisadvantage) out.push(`${l.armor.name}: desvantagem em Furtividade.`); } else if (l?.kind === 'weapon' && !weaponProficient(cls, l.weapon)) { out.push(`Sem proficiência com ${l.weapon.name}: sem bônus de proficiência no ataque.`); } } return out; }

nodes.name: levelup.ts
nodes.body_text: // Lógica pura do assistente de level up (sem React): calcula ganhos e monta o patch final. import { ABILITIES, abilityModifier, getClass, proficiencyBonus, spellSlotsFor, type AbilityKey, type ClassFeature, type Spell, type Subclass, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { SCORE_FIELDS, getSheet, scoreOf, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import { spellPlan, type SpellPlan } from '../wizard/build'; import { initialState } from '../wizard/state'; import { hitDieAverage, pactSlots } from './logic'; const MOD_FIELDS = { str: 'strengthModifier', dex: 'dexterityModifier', con: 'constitutionModifier', int: 'intelligenceModifier', wis: 'wisdomModifier', cha: 'charismaModifier', } as const; /** Níveis com aumento de atributo/talento (guerreiro e ladino ganham extras). */ /** Nível em que a classe escolhe subclasse. */ /** Incrementos de atributo da escolha (sem validar o teto). */ /** Escolha completa e que não ultrapassa 20. */ /** Plano de magias reaproveitando spellPlan do wizard, com um estado sintético. */

nodes.name: HpMode
nodes.body_text: type HpMode = 'average' | 'roll';

nodes.name: AsiMode
nodes.body_text: type AsiMode = 'plus2' | 'plus1' | 'feat';

nodes.name: AsiChoice
nodes.body_text: interface AsiChoice { mode: AsiMode; a: AbilityKey | ''; b: AbilityKey | ''; feat: string }

nodes.name: LevelUpDraft
nodes.body_text: interface LevelUpDraft { hpMode: HpMode; /** Resultado do dado de vida rolado (null = ainda não rolou). */ hpRoll: number | null; subclassId: string; asi: AsiChoice; cantrips: string[]; spells: string[]; }

nodes.name: emptyDraft
nodes.body_text: emptyDraft = (): LevelUpDraft => ({ hpMode: 'average', hpRoll: null, subclassId: '', asi: { mode: 'plus2', a: '', b: '', feat: '' }, cantrips: [], spells: [], })

nodes.name: asiLevels
nodes.body_text: function asiLevels(classId: string): number[] { const extra = classId === 'guerreiro' ? [6, 14] : classId === 'ladino' ? [10] : []; return [4, 8, 12, 16, 19, ...extra].sort((x, y) => x - y); }

nodes.name: grantsAsi
nodes.body_text: grantsAsi = (classId: string, level: number) => asiLevels(classId).includes(level)

nodes.name: classSubclassLevel
nodes.body_text: classSubclassLevel = (subs: Subclass[]) => (subs.length ? Math.min(...subs.map((s) => s.level)) : undefined)

nodes.name: asiIncrements
nodes.body_text: function asiIncrements(asi: AsiChoice): Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> { if (asi.mode === 'feat') return {}; if (asi.mode === 'plus2') return asi.a ? { [asi.a]: 2 } : {}; const out: Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> = {}; if (asi.a) out[asi.a] = 1; if (asi.b && asi.b !== asi.a) out[asi.b] = (out[asi.b] ?? 0) + 1; return out; }

nodes.name: asiValid
nodes.signature: function asiValid(scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>, asi: AsiChoice): boolean
nodes.body_text: function asiValid(scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>, asi: AsiChoice): boolean { if (asi.mode === 'feat') return asi.feat.trim().length > 0; const inc = asiIncrements(asi); const total = Object.values(inc).reduce((n, v) => n + (v ?? 0), 0); if (total !== 2) return false; return (Object.entries(inc) as [AbilityKey, number][]).every(([k, v]) => scores[k] + v <= 20); }

nodes.name: scoresOf
nodes.body_text: function scoresOf(c: Character): Record<AbilityKey, number> { return Object.fromEntries(ABILITIES.map((a) => [a.key, scoreOf(c, a.key)])) as Record<AbilityKey, number>; }

nodes.name: planFor
nodes.signature: function planFor(classId: string, subclassId: string, level: number, scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>): SpellPlan | null
nodes.body_text: function planFor(classId: string, subclassId: string, level: number, scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>): SpellPlan | null { return spellPlan({ ...initialState(), classId, subclassId, level, abilityMode: 'manual', manual: scores }); }

nodes.name: slotsFor
nodes.signature: slotsFor = (plan: SpellPlan | null, level: number): number[]
nodes.body_text: slotsFor = (plan: SpellPlan | null, level: number): number[] => !plan ? [] : plan.sc.kind === 'pact' ? pactSlots(level) : spellSlotsFor(plan.sc.kind, level)

nodes.name: SpellChoices
nodes.body_text: interface SpellChoices { oldPlan: SpellPlan | null; newPlan: SpellPlan | null; oldSlots: number[]; newSlots: number[]; needCantrips: number; needSpells: number; cantripPool: Spell[]; spellPool: Spell[]; }

nodes.name: spellChoices
nodes.signature: function spellChoices(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): SpellChoices
nodes.body_text: function spellChoices(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): SpellChoices { const sheet = getSheet(c); const newLevel = c.level + 1; const before = scoresOf(c); const after = applyScores(before, draft, newLevel, sheet.classId); const subclassId = sheet.subclassId || draft.subclassId; const oldPlan = planFor(sheet.classId, sheet.subclassId ?? '', c.level, before); const newPlan = planFor(sheet.classId, subclassId, newLevel, after); const owned = new Set(sheet.spellsKnown); const delta = (k: 'cantrips' | 'known' | 'prepared') => Math.max(0, (newPlan?.[k] ?? 0) - (oldPlan?.[k] ?? 0)); const spellKey = newPlan?.mode === 'prepared' ? 'prepared' : 'known'; const cantripPool = (newPlan?.cantripList ?? []).filter((s) => !owned.has(s.id)); const spellPool = (newPlan?.spellList ?? []).filter((s) => !owned.has(s.id)); return { oldPlan, newPlan, oldSlots: slotsFor(oldPlan, c.level), newSlots: slotsFor(newPlan, newLevel), needCantrips: Math.min(delta('cantrips'), cantripPool.length), needSpells: Math.min(delta(spellKey), spellPool.length), cantripPool, spellPool, }; }

nodes.name: delta
nodes.body_text: delta = (k: 'cantrips' | 'known' | 'prepared') => Math.max(0, (newPlan?.[k] ?? 0) - (oldPlan?.[k] ?? 0))

nodes.name: applyScores
nodes.signature: function applyScores(base: Record<AbilityKey, number>, draft: LevelUpDraft, newLevel: number, classId: string)
nodes.body_text: function applyScores(base: Record<AbilityKey, number>, draft: LevelUpDraft, newLevel: number, classId: string) { const out = { ...base }; if (!grantsAsi(classId, newLevel) || !asiValid(base, draft.asi)) return out; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(asiIncrements(draft.asi)) as [AbilityKey, number][]) out[k] = Math.min(20, out[k] + v); return out; }

nodes.name: LevelUpResult
nodes.body_text: interface LevelUpResult { newLevel: number; hitDie: number; hpBase: number; hpGain: number; /** PV retroativos por aumento de Constituição. */ hpRetro: number; pbOld: number; pbNew: number; scoresBefore: Record<AbilityKey, number>; scoresAfter: Record<AbilityKey, number>; features: ClassFeature[]; subclassNeeded: boolean; subclasses: Subclass[]; asiAvailable: boolean; spell: SpellChoices; /** Pendências que impedem confirmar (vazio = pronto). */ errors: string[]; columns: Partial<Character>; sheet: Partial<SheetData>; }

nodes.name: computeLevelUp
nodes.signature: function computeLevelUp(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): LevelUpResult
nodes.body_text: function computeLevelUp(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): LevelUpResult { const sheet = getSheet(c); const cls = getClass(sheet.classId); const newLevel = Math.min(20, c.level + 1); const die = cls?.hitDie ?? 8; const before = scoresOf(c); const asiAvailable = grantsAsi(sheet.classId, newLevel); const asiOk = !asiAvailable || asiValid(before, draft.asi); const after = applyScores(before, draft, newLevel, sheet.classId); // PV: dado (média ou rolado) + mod. de Con novo; aumento de Con vale retroativamente. const hpBase = draft.hpMode === 'roll' ? (draft.hpRoll ?? 0) : hitDieAverage(die); const conOld = abilityModifier(before.con), conNew = abilityModifier(after.con); const hpRetro = (conNew - conOld) * c.level; const hpGain = Math.max(1, hpBase + conNew) + hpRetro; const subs = cls?.subclasses ?? []; const subLv = classSubclassLevel(subs); const subclassNeeded = !sheet.subclassId && subLv !== undefined && newLevel >= subLv; const subclassId = sheet.subclassId || draft.subclassId; const sub = subs.find((s) => s.id === subclassId); const features = [ ...(cls?.features ?? []).filter((f) => f.level === newLevel), ...(sub?.features ?? []).filter((f) => f.level === newLevel || (!sheet.subclassId && f.level <= newLevel)), ]; const spell = spellChoices(c, draft); const errors: string[] = []; if (c.level >= 20) errors.push('Nível máximo atingido.'); if (draft.hpMode === 'roll' && draft.hpRoll == null) errors.push('Role o dado de vida ou escolha a média.'); if (subclassNeeded && !draft.subclassId) errors.push(`Escolha ${cls?.subclassLabel.toLowerCase() ?? 'a subclasse'}.`); if (!asiOk) errors.push('Conclua o aumento de atributo ou talento (máx. 20).'); const cant = draft.cantrips.filter((id) => spell.cantripPool.some((s) => s.id === id)); const sp = draft.spells.filter((id) => spell.spellPool.some((s) => s.id === id)); if (cant.length < spell.needCantrips) errors.push(`Escolha ${spell.needCantrips - cant.length} truque(s).`); if (sp.length < spell.needSpells) errors.push(`Escolha ${spell.needSpells - sp.length} magia(s).`); // Patch consolidado const columns: Partial<Character> = { level: newLevel, maxHitPoints: c.maxHitPoints + hpGain, currentHitPoints: c.currentHitPoints + hpGain, }; const baseScores = { ...sheet.baseScores }; for (const a of ABILITIES) { const diff = after[a.key] - before[a.key]; if (diff > 0) { (columns as Record<string, unknown>)[SCORE_FIELDS[a.key]] = after[a.key]; (columns as Record<string, unknown>)[MOD_FIELDS[a.key]] = abilityModifier(after[a.key]); baseScores[a.key] = Math.min(20, baseScores[a.key] + diff); } } const known = [...sheet.spellsKnown, ...cant, ...sp]; if (cant.length || sp.length) columns.spells = [...new Set([...(c.spells ?? []), ...cant, ...sp])]; const chosen = [...sheet.chosenFeatures]; if (asiAvailable && asiOk) { if (draft.asi.mode === 'feat') chosen.push(`Nv ${newLevel}: Talento — ${draft.asi.feat.trim()}`); else chosen.push(`Nv ${newLevel}: ${Object.entries(asiIncrements(draft.asi)).map(([k, v]) => `+${v} ${ABILITIES.find((a) => a.key === k)?.name}`).join(', ')}`); } const used = [...sheet.spellSlotsUsed]; while (used.length < spell.newSlots.length) used.push(0); const sheetPatch: Partial<SheetData> = { baseScores, spellsKnown: known, spellsPrepared: spell.newPlan?.mode === 'prepared' ? [...sheet.spellsPrepared, ...sp] : sheet.spellsPrepared, spellSlotsUsed: used, chosenFeatures: chosen, ...(subclassId ? { subclassId } : {}), }; return { newLevel, hitDie: die, hpBase, hpGain, hpRetro, pbOld: proficiencyBonus(c.level), pbNew: proficiencyBonus(newLevel), scoresBefore: before, scoresAfter: after, features, subclassNeeded, subclasses: subs, asiAvailable, spell, errors, columns, sheet: sheetPatch, }; }

nodes.name: logic.ts
nodes.body_text: import { ARMOR, abilityModifier, getClass, levelForXp, rollDice, type ClassDef } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { getSheet, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import { isEquipped } from './equipment-logic'; /** Dados de vida restantes. */ /** Sobe um nível: PV máximos aumentam pela média do dado de vida + mod. de Constituição. */ /** Aplica dano consumindo PV temporários primeiro. */ /** Bruxo: magia de pacto. */ /** Calcula a CA com base nos itens equipados (casando nomes com a tabela de armaduras). */

nodes.name: hitDieAverage
nodes.body_text: hitDieAverage = (die: number) => Math.floor(die / 2) + 1

nodes.name: hitDiceLeft
nodes.body_text: hitDiceLeft = (c: Character, sheet: SheetData) => Math.max(0, c.level - sheet.hitDiceUsed)

nodes.name: canLevelUp
nodes.body_text: function canLevelUp(c: Character) { return c.level < 20 && levelForXp(c.experience) > c.level; }

nodes.name: levelUpPatch

nodes.body_text: function applyDamage(c: Character, amount: number): Partial<Character> { const fromTemp = Math.min(c.temporaryHitPoints, amount); const rest = amount - fromTemp; return { temporaryHitPoints: c.temporaryHitPoints - fromTemp, currentHitPoints: Math.max(0, c.currentHitPoints - rest), }; }

nodes.name: pactSlots
nodes.body_text: function pactSlots(level: number): number[] { const count = level === 1 ? 1 : level < 11 ? 2 : level < 17 ? 3 : 4; const slotLevel = Math.min(5, Math.ceil(level / 2)); const arr = Array(slotLevel).fill(0); arr[slotLevel - 1] = count; return arr; }

Math.min(dex, body.cap ?? 99) : 0; total = body.base + d; parts.unshift(`${body.name} ${body.base}${body.dex ? ` ${d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d} (Des)` : ''}`); } else if (classId === 'barbaro') { total = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(c.constitution); parts.unshift('Defesa sem armadura: 10 + Des + Con'); } else if (classId === 'monge' && shield === 0) { total = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(c.wisdom); parts.unshift('Defesa sem armadura: 10 + Des + Sab'); } else { total = 10 + dex; parts.unshift(`Base 10 + Des (${dex >= 0 ? nodes.body_text: function shortRestPlan(c: Character, sheet: SheetData, diceRolls: number[]): RestPlan { const conMod = abilityModifier(c.constitution); const heal = diceRolls.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.max(0, r + conMod), 0); const hp = Math.min(c.maxHitPoints, c.currentHitPoints + heal); const lines: string[] = []; if (diceRolls.length) { lines.push(`${diceRolls.length} dado(s) de vida (${diceRolls.join(', ')} ${formatModifier(conMod)} Con cada): +${hp - c.currentHitPoints} PV (${c.currentHitPoints} → ${hp})`); } else lines.push('Nenhum dado de vida gasto.'); const resources = sheet.resources.map((r) => (r.recharge === 'short' && r.used > 0 ? { ...r, used: 0 } : r)); const reset = sheet.resources.filter((r) => r.recharge === 'short' && r.used > 0).map((r) => r.name); if (reset.length) lines.push(`Recursos restaurados: ${reset.join(', ')}`); const patch: Partial<SheetData> = { hitDiceUsed: sheet.hitDiceUsed + diceRolls.length, resources }; if (sheet.classId === 'bruxo' && sheet.spellSlotsUsed.some((n) => n > 0)) { patch.spellSlotsUsed = []; lines.push('Espaços de magia de pacto restaurados'); } if (sheet.classId === 'mago') lines.push('Recuperação Arcana: restaure espaços manualmente na aba Magias (uma vez por dia).'); return { lines, columns: { currentHitPoints: hp }, sheet: patch }; }

' (PV temporários zerados)' : ''}`, `Dados de vida: +${Math.min(regained, sheet.hitDiceUsed)} recuperado(s)`, 'Todos os espaços de magia restaurados', ]; const reset = sheet.resources.filter((r) => r.recharge !== 'manual' && r.used > 0).map((r) => r.name); if (reset.length) lines.push(`Recursos restaurados: ${reset.join(', ')}`); if (sheet.concentratingOn) lines.push('Concentração encerrada'); if (sheet.exhaustion > 0) lines.push(`Exaustão: ${sheet.exhaustion} → ${sheet.exhaustion - 1} (requer comida e água)`); if (sheet.deathSaves.successes || sheet.deathSaves.failures) lines.push('Salvaguardas contra morte zeradas'); return { lines, columns: p.columns, sheet: p.sheet }; }

nodes.body_text: function spellRollFor(s: Spell, castLevel: number): SpellRoll | null { const m = s.description.match(DICE); if (!m) return null; let n = Number(m[1]); const sides = Number(m[2]); const flat = m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : 0; const near = s.description.slice(Math.max(0, (m.index ?? 0) - 80), (m.index ?? 0) + 120).toLowerCase(); const heal = /cura|recupera|pontos de vida/.test(near) && !/dano/.test(near); if (!heal && !/dano/.test(s.description.toLowerCase())) return null; if (s.level > 0 && castLevel > s.level && s.atHigherLevels) { const up = s.atHigherLevels.match(/(\d+)d(\d+)/i); if (up && Number(up[2]) === sides) n += Number(up[1]) * (castLevel - s.level); } return { expr: `${n}d${sides}${flat ? `+${flat}` : ''}`, kind: heal ? 'cura' : 'dano' }; }

nodes.body_text: // Busca "inteligente" de magias e cartas: procura em nome e texto, aceita várias palavras // em qualquer ordem, entende sinônimos de jogador ("cura", "voar", "controle") e atalhos // ("truque", "3º", "concentração", "bônus", escola, classe). Puro: sem React. import { CLASSES, type Spell } from '@repo/rules'; import { normalizeText } from './spell-utils'; /** Palavra digitada -> trechos (já normalizados) que contam como acerto no texto. */ const SYNONYMS: Record<string, string[]> = {}; syn(['cura', 'curar', 'cure', 'heal', 'vida'], ['cura', 'curar', 'recupera', 'pontos de vida', 'restaura', 'regenera']); syn(['fogo', 'chama', 'chamas', 'fire'], ['fogo', 'chamas', 'flamej', 'incendi', 'queimad', 'brasa', 'ardente']); syn(['gelo', 'frio', 'neve', 'ice'], ['frio', 'gelo', 'congel', 'neve', 'glacial']); syn(['eletrico', 'eletricidade', 'relampago', 'choque'], ['eletric', 'relampag', 'chocante', 'choque']); syn(['trovao', 'trovejante', 'som'], ['trovao', 'trovej', 'estrond', 'ensurdecedor']); syn(['acido'], ['acid']); syn(['veneno', 'venenoso', 'envenenar'], ['venen', 'veneno']); syn(['necrotico', 'necromancia'], ['necrot', 'necromancia']); syn(['radiante', 'sagrado', 'divino'], ['radiante', 'sagrad', 'divin']); syn(['psiquico', 'mental', 'mente'], ['psiquic', 'mente', 'mental']); syn(['voar', 'voo', 'voando', 'flutuar', 'levitar'], ['voo', 'voar', 'voando', 'levita', 'flutua']); syn(['teleporte', 'teletransporte', 'teleportar'], ['teleport', 'teletransport', 'dimensional', 'desaparece', 'portal']); syn(['invisivel', 'invisibilidade', 'sumir'], ['invisiv']); syn(['controle', 'controlar', 'cc'], ['paralisad', 'amedrontad', 'enfeiticad', 'impedid', 'atordoad', 'caido', 'agarrad', 'incapacitad', 'imobiliz', 'restringid', 'inconscient', 'cego', 'surdo']); syn(['medo', 'assustar', 'amedrontar'], ['amedront', 'medo', 'pavor', 'terror']); syn(['dormir', 'sono'], ['sono', 'dorm', 'inconscient']); syn(['protecao', 'proteger', 'defesa', 'defender'], ['classe de armadura', 'resistencia a', 'protec', 'escudo', 'barreira']); syn(['invocar', 'convocar', 'summon'], ['invoca', 'convoca', 'conjura', 'surge', 'criatura aparece']); syn(['area', 'aoe'], ['de raio', 'em um raio', 'cone', 'cubo', 'linha de', 'esfera de', 'cilindro', 'emanacao', 'cada criatura']); syn(['buff', 'bonus'], ['vantagem', 'bonus', 'adiciona']); syn(['debuff', 'maldicao', 'amaldicoar'], ['desvantagem', 'maldic', 'subtrai', 'penalidade']); syn(['luz', 'iluminar'], ['luz', 'ilumina', 'brilh']); syn(['escuridao', 'sombra'], ['escurid', 'sombra']); syn(['agua', 'mar'], ['agua', 'mar', 'onda', 'respirar']); syn(['terra', 'pedra', 'rocha'], ['terra', 'pedra', 'rocha', 'solo']); syn(['vento', 'ar'], ['vento', 'rajada', 'tornado', 'redemoinho']); syn(['planta', 'plantas', 'natureza'], ['planta', 'vinha', 'arvore', 'espinho', 'vegeta']); syn(['animal', 'animais', 'besta'], ['animal', 'animais', 'besta', 'fera']); syn(['mortos', 'morto', 'zumbi', 'esqueleto', 'morte'], ['morto', 'cadaver', 'zumbi', 'esquelet', 'morte']); syn(['reviver', 'ressuscitar', 'ressurreicao'], ['reviv', 'ressusc', 'ressurrei', 'de volta a vida']); syn(['detectar', 'descobrir', 'revelar', 'achar'], ['detect', 'sentir', 'percebe', 'localiz', 'revela', 'encontr']); syn(['comunicar', 'conversar', 'falar', 'idioma'], ['telepat', 'mensag', 'idioma', 'falar com', 'comunica']); syn(['velocidade', 'rapido', 'correr'], ['velocid', 'deslocamento', 'rapid', 'disparada']); syn(['cegar', 'cego', 'cegueira'], ['cego', 'cegueira', 'cegad']); syn(['empurrar', 'afastar', 'derrubar'], ['empurr', 'afast', 'arremess', 'caido']); syn(['furtivo', 'furtividade', 'esconder', 'disfarce'], ['furtiv', 'escond', 'disfarc', 'oculta']); syn(['dano'], ['dano']); const STOPWORDS = new Set(['de', 'da', 'do', 'das', 'dos', 'que', 'com', 'em', 'a', 'o', 'e', 'as', 'os', 'para', 'um', 'uma', 'no', 'na']); const SCHOOLS: Record<string, string> = { abjuracao: 'Abjuração', conjuracao: 'Conjuração', adivinhacao: 'Adivinhação', encantamento: 'Encantamento', evocacao: 'Evocação', ilusao: 'Ilusão', necromancia: 'Necromancia', transmutacao: 'Transmutação', }; const CLASS_BY_WORD: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(CLASSES.map((c) => [normalizeText(c.name), c.id])); /** Nenhuma palavra nem atalho: tudo casa. */ /** * Pontua um texto contra as palavras da busca. -1 = alguma palavra não aparece. * Nome vale mais que descrição; palavra exata vale mais que sinônimo. */ /** `needle` aparece no começo de alguma palavra de `hay` ("cura" não casa com "loucura"). */ const spellIndex = new WeakMap<Spell, { name: string; text: string }>(); /** Pontuação da magia para a busca; -1 = fora. Com busca vazia, 0. */

nodes.name: syn
nodes.body_text: syn = (keys: string[], hits: string[]) => { for (const k of keys) SYNONYMS[k] = hits; }

nodes.name: CostFacet
nodes.body_text: type CostFacet = 'acao' | 'bonus' | 'reacao';

nodes.name: ParsedQuery
nodes.body_text: interface ParsedQuery { /** Palavras que precisam aparecer (cada uma pode casar por sinônimo). */ terms: string[]; /** A busca inteira, para o bônus de frase exata no nome. */ phrase: string; level?: number; concentration?: boolean; ritual?: boolean; cost?: CostFacet; school?: string; classId?: string; }

nodes.name: parseQuery
nodes.body_text: function parseQuery(raw: string): ParsedQuery { const phrase = normalizeText(raw.trim()); const words = phrase.split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(Boolean); const pq: ParsedQuery = { terms: [], phrase }; for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i++) { const w = words[i]!; const lvl = w.match(/^(?:nivel|circulo|nv)?([0-9])(?:o|º|°)?$/); if (w === 'truque' || w === 'truques') pq.level = 0; else if (lvl) pq.level = Number(lvl[1]); else if (w === 'concentracao' || w === 'conc') pq.concentration = true; else if (w === 'ritual') pq.ritual = true; else if (w === 'reacao') pq.cost = 'reacao'; else if (w === 'bonus' && (words[i - 1] === 'acao' || pq.cost === 'acao')) pq.cost = 'bonus'; else if (w === 'acao') pq.cost = words[i + 1] === 'bonus' ? 'bonus' : 'acao'; else if (SCHOOLS[w]) pq.school = SCHOOLS[w]; else if (CLASS_BY_WORD[w]) pq.classId = CLASS_BY_WORD[w]; else if (!STOPWORDS.has(w)) pq.terms.push(w); } if (pq.cost === 'bonus') pq.terms = pq.terms.filter((t) => t !== 'bonus'); return pq; }

nodes.name: queryEmpty
nodes.body_text: queryEmpty = (pq: ParsedQuery) => !pq.terms.length && pq.level === undefined && !pq.concentration && !pq.ritual && !pq.cost && !pq.school && !pq.classId

nodes.name: hasWord
nodes.signature: function hasWord(hay: string, needle: string): boolean
nodes.body_text: function hasWord(hay: string, needle: string): boolean { for (let i = hay.indexOf(needle); i >= 0; i = hay.indexOf(needle, i + 1)) { if (i === 0 || !/[a-z0-9]/.test(hay[i - 1]!)) return true; } return false; }

nodes.name: scoreText
nodes.signature: function scoreText(name: string, text: string, pq: ParsedQuery): number
nodes.body_text: function scoreText(name: string, text: string, pq: ParsedQuery): number { let score = 0; for (const t of pq.terms) { const hits = SYNONYMS[t] ?? []; if (hasWord(name, t)) score += name.startsWith(t) ? 15 : 10; else if (hits.some((h) => name.startsWith(h))) score += 12; else if (hits.some((h) => hasWord(name, h))) score += 8; else if (hasWord(text, t)) score += 3; else if (hits.some((h) => hasWord(text, h))) score += 2; else return -1; } if (pq.phrase && pq.terms.length > 1 && name.includes(pq.phrase)) score += 20; return score; }

nodes.name: spellCost
nodes.body_text: spellCost = (s: Pick<Spell, 'castingTime'>): CostFacet | undefined => { const t = normalizeText(s.castingTime); if (t.includes('bonus')) return 'bonus'; if (t.includes('reacao')) return 'reacao'; if (/\b1 acao\b/.test(t) || t === 'acao') return 'acao'; return undefined; }

nodes.name: indexOf
nodes.body_text: function indexOf(s: Spell) { let ix = spellIndex.get(s); if (!ix) { const classes = s.classes.map((id) => CLASSES.find((c) => c.id === id)?.name ?? id).join(' '); ix = { name: normalizeText(s.name), text: normalizeText([s.description, s.atHigherLevels ?? '', s.school, classes, s.range, s.duration, s.castingTime, s.components.m ?? ''].join(' ')), }; spellIndex.set(s, ix); } return ix; }

nodes.name: scoreSpell
nodes.signature: function scoreSpell(s: Spell, pq: ParsedQuery): number
nodes.body_text: function scoreSpell(s: Spell, pq: ParsedQuery): number { if (pq.level !== undefined && s.level !== pq.level) return -1; if (pq.concentration && !s.concentration) return -1; if (pq.ritual && !s.ritual) return -1; if (pq.cost && spellCost(s) !== pq.cost) return -1; if (pq.school && s.school !== pq.school) return -1; if (pq.classId && !s.classes.includes(pq.classId)) return -1; const ix = indexOf(s); return scoreText(ix.name, ix.text, pq); }

nodes.name: capitalize

Seguro para SSR: servidor vê lista vazia. */

nodes.name: read
nodes.body_text: function read(): string[] { try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY); if (raw === cache.raw) return cache.list; const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string') : EMPTY; cache = { raw, list }; return list; } catch { return EMPTY; } }

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.body_text: function subscribe(cb: () => void) { listeners.add(cb); const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === KEY) cb(); }; window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage); return () => { listeners.delete(cb); window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage); }; }

nodes.name: onStorage
nodes.body_text: onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === KEY) cb(); }

nodes.name: useSpellFavorites
nodes.body_text: function useSpellFavorites() { const favorites = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, read, () => EMPTY); const toggle = useCallback((id: string) => { const cur = read(); const next = cur.includes(id) ? cur.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...cur, id]; try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* storage indisponível */ } listeners.forEach((l) => l()); }, []); return { favorites, toggle }; }

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.body_text: // Lógica pura de derivação do wizard: nenhuma dependência de React. import { ABILITIES, POINT_BUY_BUDGET, POINT_BUY_COST, SKILLS, STANDARD_ARRAY, XP_BY_LEVEL, abilityModifier, getBackground, getClass, getRace, spellSlotsFor, spellsForClass, type AbilityKey, type Background, type ClassDef, type Race, type SkillKey, type Spell, type SpellcastingInfo, type Subclass, type Subrace, } from "@repo/rules"; import type { Character } from "@/lib/api"; import { emptySheet, type SheetData } from "@/lib/sheet"; import { applyWeapon, matchArmor, matchWeapon, norm, parseEquipLine, toItems, weaponSlot, weaponsForSlot, type Item, } from "./equipment"; import type { AbMap, StepId, WizardState } from "./state"; export const LANGUAGES = [ "Comum", "Anão", "Élfico", "Gigante", "Gnômico", "Goblin", "Halfling", "Orc", "Abissal", "Celestial", "Dracônico", "Língua Profunda", "Infernal", "Primordial", "Silvestre", "Subcomum", ]; export const ABILITY_NAME = Object.fromEntries(ABILITIES.map((a) => [a.key, a.name])) as Record<AbilityKey, string>; export const ABILITY_ABBR = Object.fromEntries(ABILITIES.map((a) => [a.key, a.abbr])) as Record<AbilityKey, string>; export const SKILL_NAME = Object.fromEntries(SKILLS.map((s) => [s.key, s.name])) as Record<SkillKey, string>; // ───────────── Seletores básicos ───────────── /** Nível em que a classe escolhe a subclasse (undefined se não tem). */ // ───────────── Atributos ───────────── // ───────────── Perícias, idiomas, ferramentas ───────────── /** Perícias que não podem ser escolhidas numa fonte, por já virem de outra. */ // ───────────── Magias ───────────── /** Escolhas de magia válidas e dentro dos limites. */ // ───────────── Equipamento ───────────── // ───────────── Pontos de vida ───────────── // ───────────── Características ───────────── // ───────────── Validação por passo ───────────── // ───────────── Payload final ───────────── const MOD_FIELDS = { str: "strengthModifier", dex: "dexterityModifier", con: "constitutionModifier", int: "intelligenceModifier", wis: "wisdomModifier", cha: "charismaModifier", } as const;

nodes.name: raceOf
nodes.body_text: raceOf = (s: WizardState): Race | undefined => getRace(s.raceId)

nodes.name: subraceOf
nodes.body_text: subraceOf = (s: WizardState): Subrace | undefined => raceOf(s)?.subraces.find((x) => x.id === s.subraceId)

nodes.name: classOf
nodes.body_text: classOf = (s: WizardState): ClassDef | undefined => getClass(s.classId)

nodes.name: subclassOf
nodes.body_text: subclassOf = (s: WizardState): Subclass | undefined => classOf(s)?.subclasses.find((x) => x.id === s.subclassId)

nodes.name: backgroundOf
nodes.body_text: backgroundOf = (s: WizardState): Background | undefined => getBackground(s.backgroundId)

nodes.name: subclassLevel
nodes.body_text: subclassLevel = (c?: ClassDef) => (c?.subclasses.length ? Math.min(...c.subclasses.map((x) => x.level)) : undefined)

nodes.name: subclassRequired
nodes.body_text: subclassRequired = (s: WizardState) => { const lv = subclassLevel(classOf(s)); return lv !== undefined && s.level >= lv; }

nodes.name: extraLanguageCount
nodes.body_text: function extraLanguageCount(race?: Race, sub?: Subrace) { const subExtra = sub?.traits.some((t) => /idioma adicional/i.test(t.name + " " + t.description) && /idioma/i.test(t.name)) ? 1 : 0; return (race?.extraLanguages ?? 0) + subExtra; }

nodes.name: raceSkillPickCount
nodes.body_text: raceSkillPickCount = (race?: Race) => (race?.id === "meio-elfo" ? 2 : 0)

nodes.name: racialBonuses
nodes.body_text: function racialBonuses(s: WizardState): Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> { const race = raceOf(s), sub = subraceOf(s); const out: Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> = {}; const add = (k: AbilityKey, n: number) => { out[k] = (out[k] ?? 0) + n; }; for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(race?.abilityBonuses ?? {})) add(k as AbilityKey, n as number); for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(sub?.abilityBonuses ?? {})) add(k as AbilityKey, n as number); if (race?.abilityChoice) for (const k of s.racialPicks.slice(0, race.abilityChoice.count)) add(k, race.abilityChoice.amount); return out; }

nodes.name: add
nodes.body_text: add = (k: AbilityKey, n: number) => { out[k] = (out[k] ?? 0) + n; }

nodes.name: pointBuySpent
nodes.body_text: pointBuySpent = (pb: AbMap<number>) => ABILITIES.reduce((n, a) => n + (POINT_BUY_COST[pb[a.key]] ?? 0), 0)

nodes.name: rollTotal
nodes.body_text: rollTotal = (dice: number[]) => dice.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) - Math.min(...dice)

nodes.name: baseScores
nodes.body_text: function baseScores(s: WizardState): AbMap<number> { const out = {} as AbMap<number>; for (const a of ABILITIES) { let v: number | null | undefined; if (s.abilityMode === "standard") v = s.standard[a.key]; else if (s.abilityMode === "pointbuy") v = s.pointBuy[a.key]; else if (s.abilityMode === "manual") v = s.manual[a.key]; else { const i = s.rollAssign[a.key]; v = i == null || !s.rolls[i] ? null : rollTotal(s.rolls[i]); } out[a.key] = v ?? 10; } return out; }

nodes.name: finalScores
nodes.body_text: function finalScores(s: WizardState): AbMap<number> { const base = baseScores(s), bonus = racialBonuses(s), out = {} as AbMap<number>; for (const a of ABILITIES) out[a.key] = Math.min(20, base[a.key] + (bonus[a.key] ?? 0)); return out; }

nodes.name: abilitiesComplete
nodes.body_text: function abilitiesComplete(s: WizardState): boolean { if (s.abilityMode === "standard") { const vals = ABILITIES.map((a) => s.standard[a.key]); return vals.every((v) => v != null) && new Set(vals).size === STANDARD_ARRAY.length; } if (s.abilityMode === "manual") return true; if (s.abilityMode === "pointbuy") return pointBuySpent(s.pointBuy) <= POINT_BUY_BUDGET; const idx = ABILITIES.map((a) => s.rollAssign[a.key]); return s.rolls.length === 6 && idx.every((i) => i != null) && new Set(idx).size === 6; }

nodes.name: SpellPlan
nodes.body_text: interface SpellPlan { sc: SpellcastingInfo; mode: "known" | "prepared" | "book"; cantrips: number; /** nº de magias de 1º nível+ a conhecer (known/book) */ known: number; /** nº de magias a preparar (prepared/book) */ prepared: number; maxLevel: number; cantripList: Spell[]; spellList: Spell[]; }

nodes.name: spellPlan
nodes.body_text: function spellPlan(s: WizardState): SpellPlan | null { const cls = classOf(s); if (!cls) return null; const sub = subclassOf(s) as (Subclass & { spellcasting?: SpellcastingInfo }) | undefined; const sc = cls.spellcasting ?? (sub && s.level >= sub.level ? sub.spellcasting : undefined); if (!sc) return null; const lvl = s.level; const mod = abilityModifier(finalScores(s)[sc.ability]); const cantrips = sc.cantripsKnown?.[lvl - 1] ?? 0; const maxLevel = sc.kind === "pact" ? Math.min(5, Math.ceil(lvl / 2)) : spellSlotsFor(sc.kind, lvl).length; let mode: SpellPlan["mode"] = "known", known = 0, prepared = 0; if (sc.preparesSpells) { if (cls.id === "mago") { mode = "book"; known = 6 + 2 * (lvl - 1); prepared = Math.max(1, lvl + mod); } else { mode = "prepared"; prepared = Math.max(1, (sc.kind === "half" ? Math.floor(lvl / 2) : lvl) + mod); } } else known = sc.spellsKnown?.[lvl - 1] ?? 0; if (maxLevel === 0) { known = 0; prepared = 0; } if (cantrips === 0 && known === 0 && prepared === 0) return null; const list = spellsForClass(sc.kind === "third" ? "mago" : cls.id, maxLevel); return { sc, mode, cantrips, known, prepared, maxLevel, cantripList: list.filter((x) => x.level === 0), spellList: list.filter((x) => x.level >= 1), }; }

nodes.name: resolvedSpells
nodes.body_text: function resolvedSpells(s: WizardState) { const plan = spellPlan(s); if (!plan) return { cantrips: [] as string[], spells: [] as string[], prepared: [] as string[], plan }; const okC = new Set(plan.cantripList.map((x) => x.id)), okS = new Set(plan.spellList.map((x) => x.id)); const cantrips = s.cantrips.filter((id) => okC.has(id)).slice(0, plan.cantrips); const spells = s.spells.filter((id) => okS.has(id)).slice(0, plan.mode === "prepared" ? plan.prepared : plan.known); const prepared = plan.mode === "book" ? s.prepared.filter((id) => spells.includes(id)).slice(0, plan.prepared) : []; return { cantrips, spells, prepared, plan }; }

nodes.name: classEquipmentLines
nodes.body_text: function classEquipmentLines(s: WizardState): ResolvedLine[] { const cls = classOf(s); if (!cls) return []; return cls.startingEquipment.map((line, index) => { const p = parseEquipLine(line); const text = p.options ? p.options[Math.min(s.equipChoices[index] ?? 0, p.options.length - 1)] ?? "" : p.fixed; const slot = weaponSlot(text); return { index, text: slot ? applyWeapon(text, s.equipWeapons[index] ?? weaponsForSlot(slot)[0]?.name ?? "arma") : text, slot }; }); }

nodes.name: startingItems
nodes.body_text: function startingItems(s: WizardState): Item[] { const items: Item[] = []; for (const l of classEquipmentLines(s)) items.push(...toItems(l.text)); for (const e of backgroundOf(s)?.equipment ?? []) items.push(...toItems(e, false)); const merged = new Map<string, Item>(); for (const it of items) { const prev = merged.get(norm(it.name)); if (prev) prev.quantity += it.quantity; else merged.set(norm(it.name), { ...it }); } return [...merged.values()]; }

nodes.name: computeArmorClass
nodes.signature: function computeArmorClass(s: WizardState, items: Item[], scores: AbMap<number>): number
nodes.body_text: function computeArmorClass(s: WizardState, items: Item[], scores: AbMap<number>): number { const dex = abilityModifier(scores.dex); let armor: ReturnType<typeof matchArmor>; let shield = false; for (const it of items) { const a = matchArmor(it.name); if (!a) continue; if (a.category === "Escudo") shield = true; else if (!armor) armor = a; } let ac = 10 + dex; if (armor) { const base = parseInt(armor.ac, 10); ac = armor.category === "Leve" ? base + dex : armor.category === "Média" ? base + Math.min(dex, 2) : base; } else if (s.classId === "barbaro") ac = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(scores.con); else if (s.classId === "monge" && !shield) ac = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(scores.wis); return ac + (shield ? 2 : 0); }

nodes.name: hitPointsFor
nodes.signature: function hitPointsFor(s: WizardState, scores: AbMap<number>): number
nodes.body_text: function hitPointsFor(s: WizardState, scores: AbMap<number>): number { const cls = classOf(s); const hd = cls?.hitDie ?? 8, con = abilityModifier(scores.con); let hp = Math.max(1, hd + con); for (let l = 2; l <= s.level; l++) hp += Math.max(1, Math.floor(hd / 2) + 1 + con); if (subraceOf(s)?.id === "anao-da-colina") hp += s.level; return hp; }
